title: xmrgateway configuration

listen.description: Address the HTTP server listens on.

request_timeout.description: Deadline for each HTTP request, from the first byte read to the last byte written.

static_dir.description: Directory written by `xmrgateway deploy` and served at /static/.

public_url.description: Clearnet base URL used in the commands shown to users.

onion_url.description: Onion service base URL, advertised with the Onion-Location header.

clearnet_hosts.description: Host names whose responses carry the Onion-Location header.

donation_address.description: Monero address shown on the home page.

secret.description: HMAC key that signs API tokens. Changing it invalidates every token.

token_validity.description: How long an API token stays valid; 2160h is 90 days. Tokens never outlive this, and lowering it also shortens tokens already issued.

challenge_lifetime.description: How long a challenge can be redeemed after it was issued.

challenge_min_wait.description: Minimum time between requesting a challenge and redeeming it, however fast the client solves it.

pow_difficulty.description: Leading zero bits the hashcash stamp must have. Each extra bit doubles the work.

rate_limit.description: Minimum time between two price requests with the same token.

price_refresh.description: How often the price worker polls the sources and swaps in the new prices.

price_max_age.description: Quotes older than this are ignored, and the API stops answering if the last refresh is older.

max_deviation_bps.description: Quotes further than this from the median are rejected, in basis points (500 = 5%).

upstream_proxy.description: Proxy for upstream requests, e.g. socks5h://127.0.0.1:9050 to poll sources through Tor.

description: Every field except secret is optional. A missing or zero value takes the default shown here.
